intent_en: To highlight WeWork's status among top global startups and the controversy regarding its valuation.
previous_intent: To illustrate the relative valuations of top startups including WeWork, Uber, and DiDi, highlighting WeWork's high market position and the controversy surrounding its overvaluation.
narration_support: WeWork is the fourth highest valued startup in the world, just behind Uber and its Chinese competitor. Many have called it massively overvalued, even the most overvalued.
chart_support: Horizontal bar chart titled 'Top Startup Valuations' comparing the relative valuations of Toutiao, Uber, DiDi, and WeWork.
evidence_note: Narration explicitly states WeWork's high rank and overvaluation criticism. Chart visualizes the top 4 valuations with WeWork as the lowest of the group, supporting the ranking claim.
